items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: Chester, he's a little late comer, him. Chester's drummer in the old age.

ctx.x: Yeah, on Belwyn Street. He played the first dance at this Belwyn Park, they call it. And I went back there with a little bit of kid listening at him. He's playing good. And then when I did pick it up to understand he's playing good, but he gave it up and got on the trampoline. Yeah, he was a good drummer too. But they had drummers in the old age better than him. But it's been way back, I can't call any name. Now, Si, he's a good drummer. Si, he's a good drummer. Chester, he's a little late comer, him. Chester's…
